Home.hotspot_section_desc: Touch the numbered points on the visual diagram to discover the superior design features of the ATAK smoker.
Home.hotspot_1_desc: High-quality, thick 304 stainless steel body is fully resistant to corrosion and high temperatures up to 1200°C. Works without deforming for years.
Home.hotspot_2_desc: When pumped, air is fed into the combustion chamber not only from the bottom but also from the side channels. This way, the smoker does not run out of oxygen while waiting and never goes out.
Home.hotspot_3_desc: The thick genuine leather bellows with superior elasticity and air compression ratio allows you to get maximum smoke efficiency with minimum hand effort.

Home.reviews_desc: Real experiences of over 3,500 beekeepers across Turkey about ATAK quality since 2021.
Home.faq_q1: How long does a bee smoker last?
Home.faq_a1: As Atak Arıcılık, we use high-quality stainless steel (inox) body and heat shield in our bee smokers. Depending on frequency of use and maintenance conditions, our products can be used safely for many years with first-day performance without rusting or melting, compared to standard smokers. Keeping the bellows (leather/air mechanism) away from moisture directly extends its lifespan.
Home.faq_q2: What is the same-day cargo and delivery time?
Home.faq_a2: All orders placed before 15:00 on weekdays are shipped to cargo on the same day. Delivery time varies depending on your region, but is generally completed within 1 to 3 business days. Your cargo tracking number is sent to you via SMS and e-mail when your package is on its way.
Home.faq_q3: Is there a discount or dealer sales for wholesale purchases?
Home.faq_a3: Yes, as a manufacturing company, we have special wholesale price policies for beekeeping associations, agricultural credit cooperatives, chambers of agriculture and dealers selling beekeeping supplies. To learn the discount rates according to your wholesale order volumes and to apply for dealership, you can contact us from our contact page or directly from our corporate line.
Home.faq_q4: What types of fuel are recommended for Atak Arıcılık smokers?
Home.faq_a4: Thanks to the internal grate structure of our smokers that provides high air circulation and homogeneous smoke production, sawdust, dried plant leaves, cardboard or special beekeeper pellets frequently preferred in beekeeping can be easily used. We recommend preferring completely natural fuels without chemicals for the health and calming of bee colonies.
Home.faq_q5: How does your warranty and technical support process work?
Home.faq_a5: As part of our domestic production, all our bee smokers are under our company's warranty guarantee against manufacturing and material defects. Technical service and spare parts support such as bellows leather replacement and spring mechanism revision that you may need during use are provided uninterruptedly and quickly by Atak Arıcılık.
Home.faq_q6: Which body size should I prefer when buying a smoker?
Home.faq_a6: We have large and standard size alternatives depending on your number of hives and field usage intensity. We recommend our large-size smokers that offer longer smoke capacity for professional beekeepers and producers with a high number of hives; and our standard-size models that provide ergonomic use with their lightness for hobby beekeepers or producers with fewer hives.

About.title: About Us
About.paragraph1: As Atak Arıcılık, we combine traditional beekeeping experience with modern production technologies, adding value to our beekeepers' efforts with our high-quality equipment. Since our establishment, we have had one motto:
About.paragraph2: Our local and original equipment, manufactured with 304 stainless steel sheets in our Erzurum factory, is offered for sale after undergoing durability tests. We are proud to be the address of quality and trust in the sector.
About.vision_text: To deliver the highest quality equipment to our beekeepers and dealers all over Turkey in the fastest way, and to become the leading domestic brand in the beekeeping sector.
About.hero_subtitle: Since 2021, we combine traditional beekeeping experience with modern production technologies, adding value to our beekeepers' efforts with our high-quality equipment.
About.story_title: Safe Touch to the Future of Beekeeping: Who Are We?
About.story_p1: In 2021, we began our journey with the production of the bee smoker, one of the most fundamental and vital needs of the beekeeping sector. Since our establishment, combining traditional beekeeping culture with modern production technologies, we have made it our mission to both facilitate the work of our beekeepers and protect the health of bee colonies.
About.story_p2: By rapidly increasing our production capacity and product variety, we became the address of quality and trust in the sector. Today, under the Atak Arıcılık brand, we bring together a wide product range that meets all the needs of the beekeeping sector under one roof, alongside our durable and ergonomic bee smokers with high material quality.
About.story_bullet_1: Thick Sheet Metal Manufacturing at Our Own Facility
About.story_bullet_4: Instant Delivery to All 81 Provinces of Turkey
About.founding_text: Since 2021, local and original ATAK equipment produced with 304 stainless steel sheets in our Erzurum factory.
About.mission_text: To produce first-class beekeeping equipment that adds value to our beekeepers' labor and performs at the highest level even under the most challenging field conditions, and to deliver it to all corners of Turkey through our reliable supply network.
About.vision_card_text: With our innovative R&D investments, to become the first domestic manufacturer that comes to mind when beekeeping smokers and beekeeping equipment are mentioned in Turkey, and to become a pioneering brand at international standards by taking our quality to the global market.

Legal.privacy_subtitle: Information text on the security and protection of your personal data.
Legal.privacy_intro: As Atak Arıcılık, the security of personal data of producers and customers visiting our website is our highest priority. This text explains which data we process for what purpose, in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).
Legal.privacy_section1_title: Data Collected and Purpose of Use
Legal.privacy_section1_text: Information such as name, surname, phone, email and delivery address that you share during order, membership or contact forms on our site are processed on our secure servers for the purpose of delivering your orders without any problems, conducting invoicing processes and improving the quality of our customer services.
Legal.privacy_section2_text: Your personal data is never shared with third parties or sold for commercial purposes except for legal obligations and completion of logistics/cargo processes (order delivery).

Legal.terms_section2_text: Atak Arıcılık reserves the right to make changes to product prices, stock statuses, technical specifications and contract texts on the site without prior notice.
Legal.returns_subtitle: All details about the cancellation and return conditions of the products you purchased.
Legal.returns_intro: Your satisfaction with our Atak Arıcılık branded products and beekeeping equipment is valuable to us. Our return conditions valid within the scope of the Consumer Protection Law are listed below.
Legal.returns_section1_text: You can return the products you purchased from our site within 14 (fourteen) days from the delivery date without showing any reason and without paying a penal clause.
Legal.returns_section2_text: Products to be returned must be undamaged, unused and not having lost their resalable quality, together with their box, packaging and any standard accessories. Returns of products that have been used, operated in the field in beekeeping activities or deformed are not accepted.
Legal.returns_section3_text: Within 7 to 10 business days following return approval, the product price is refunded to the bank card or payment method you used to make the purchase.
